_comment: v3.61 (Phase 13): companion-tool registry. Each entry declares a tool BD knows about so the UI 'Tools' menu can list them and indicate which are present. BD does NOT execute these automatically — the registry is descriptive metadata. 'script' is resolved relative to the tools/ directory.

tools.name: Rotate API token
tools.description: Generate a fresh bearer token and write it into app_config.json.

tools.name: Validate sites_config.json
tools.description: Dry-run validate every site config; usable as a git pre-commit hook.

tools.name: bd-doctor
tools.description: Environment, dependency, and cookie diagnostics. Also available as 'bdctl doctor'.

tools.name: Security probe (DAST)
tools.description: 12-section in-process security probe. Run via tools/dast.sh.
